items.question: John and his two brothers decide to split the cost of an apartment.  It is 40% more expensive than John's old apartment which costs $1200 per month.  How much does John save per year by splitting the apartment compared to living alone?

Donna made a cake to take to a party where the guests ate half the cake. The day after the party, she shared half the leftovers with her brothers. The following day, she ate one piece as a midnight snack. Twice as many pieces as her snack were left. How many pieces was the cake to begin with?

previous_f3_program: consume("party_guests_eat", "party.guests", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), fraction(at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("the guests ate half the cake"))

transfer("share_with_brothers", "donna", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), at("donna.brothers.cake_pieces.count", "current"), fraction(at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("she shared half the leftovers with her brothers"))
consume("midnight_snack", "donna", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), 1, source("she ate one piece as a midnight snack"))
multiple(at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "after_midnight_snack"), event_field("midnight_snack", "quantity"), 2, source("Twice as many pieces as her snack were left"))

items.question: Keiko sent 111 text messages last week. This week she sent 50 less than double what she sent last week. How many text messages did Keiko send last week and this week combined?

previous_f3_program: collection("keiko.sent_text_messages", "text_message", "keiko", source("Keiko sent 111 text messages last week"))
observe(at("keiko.sent_text_messages.count", "last_week"), 111, "count", source("Keiko sent 111 text messages last week"))

offset(at("keiko.sent_text_messages.count", "this_week"), scale(at("keiko.sent_text_messages.count", "last_week"), 2), -50, "count", source("This week she sent 50 less than double what she sent last week"))
